home.label: Pastek Art
home.descriptionWide: A guided path to spark creativity, move through an exercise gently, then keep a trace of your practice — all on this device.
home.tracesEnd: of your practice on this device.
home.filEmpty: Your rituals and starters leave a trace here, automatically.

settings.heroDescription: Customise the app. Optional: back up your Thread to Google Drive.
settings.languageHint: Mirrors and prompts already generated stay in their original language. Future invitations will follow this choice once wired (next step).
settings.accountBody: No Pastek account required. The app works offline on this device. Optional: connect Google Drive below to back up your Thread.
settings.driveHint: Local-first backup / restore — no Pastek account
settings.aiEnginesHint: Mistral, Claude or OpenAI — key stored only on this device
settings.promptsHint: View system prompts and customise them locally
settings.techniquesHint: Enable, disable or add your techniques
settings.appearanceHint: Light theme (cream & watermelon) or dark (bark & mint) for the whole app.
settings.filHint: All your traces — rituals and starters
settings.privacyHint: Local data, AI sending, your rights
settings.timerHint: A gentle signal when creative time is up.
settings.apiDown: Server unreachable — check the URL or network
settings.apiAiMissing: AI not configured (HF_TOKEN missing on Vercel). Exercises and photo reflection use fallback mode.
settings.apiTroubleshoot: Local web: restart with npm run mobile:web:clear after npm install. On phone: use your PC's local IP in EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL. Also check ALLOWED_ORIGINS on Vercel.
settings.backupHint: Export your Creative Thread, preferences and ritual draft as a JSON file — yours alone. Restore it on another device with no Pastek account or server.
settings.localHint: All your traces are saved automatically in the Creative Thread on this device. To switch phone or tablet, export then restore a backup.
settings.eraseHint: Deletes the Creative Thread, ritual draft and preferences on this device. Export a backup first if you want to keep your traces.
settings.eraseConfirmWeb:
Erase all local data?

Creative Thread, draft, preferences — everything on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.eraseConfirmBody: Creative Thread, draft and preferences will be deleted on this device. Irreversible.
settings.eraseDoneBody: The app has been reset on this device.
settings.restoreDoneBody_one: {{count}} trace restored to the Creative Thread.
settings.restoreDoneBody_other: {{count}} traces restored to the Creative Thread.
settings.supportHint: Help keep this app free and kind.
settings.driveNotConfigured: Google Drive client not configured on this build.
settings.storageBody: By default everything stays on this device. Connect your Drive for a personal backup — no Pastek account, no server database.
settings.storageStatusConnected: Connected to Google Drive (not synced yet)
settings.storageStatusSynced: Connected to Google Drive · Last sync: {{date}}
settings.storageConfigHint: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_ID to the web build — the same Google Client ID as GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_ID on the API (with secret). Redirect URI: site origin + /app/premium-cloud.
